basic_info.description: A Symphony of Style awaits you in this urban retreat adjacent to SF's Performing Arts District. Located on a tree-lined side street, this incredibly well-located 2BD, 2BA residence is just a few blocks from the SF Symphony, Opera, Jazz Center, Japantown, Nob Hill, Pac Heights and more. The expansive Great Room features hardwood floors, a modern kitchen with gas and stainless steel appliances, in-ceiling speakers, floor-to-ceiling windows, glorious skylight and a corner fireplace. Both bedrooms, each with en suite bathrooms, are located on opposite sides of the home, ensuring privacy and comfort. The primary bedroom has a juliette balcony, an extra large walk-in closet and a bright skylight in the bath. Rare and envious 2-car side-by-side garage with EV plug plus abundant in-unit storage.This residence includes in-unit Laundry, dedicated solar panels and alarm system. The building, a boutique and newer construction (2010) 8-unit gem, also boasts a fabulous roof deck with panoramic views, deck furniture and BBQ grill just one flight up from your future front door.
